podcast.body: Recorded over a month in Los Angeles in October 2013, this album was the first to feature Anthony as keyboardist. The band secured Tony Hoffer, known for producing Phoenix, M83, and Beck, after he unexpectedly contacted them via MySpace in 2013, despite earlier attempts to reach him. They rehearsed for two months in Hamilton at Spice Factory, treating it like a "day job," before the L.A. sessions where synthesizers played a prominent role; Anthony subsequently purchased Hoffer's Korg GX3P and Roland D50 keyboards used on the record. "It is the first record with, uh, with Tony in the mix."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
